title: Memory and garbage collection — concept map
intro: The Common Language Runtime (CLR) owns the managed heap and reclaims objects you no longer reference. This module covers stack versus heap layout, generations and the Large Object Heap (LOH) and Pinned Object Heap (POH), mark-and-compact collection, ArrayPool and MemoryPool, pinning and weak references, Dispose versus finalizers, allocation traps, garbage collection modes for microservices, and how that compares to V8 in Node.js.

overviewDiagram.title: Managed memory lifecycle
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  A[Allocate on managed heap] --> B{Size}
  B -->|Small| C[Gen 0 SOH]
  B -->|Large 85KB+| D[LOH]
  B -->|Pinned| P[POH]
  C --> E[GC marks from roots]
  E --> F[Compact survivors]
  F --> G[Reclaim dead objects]
  D -->|CompactOnce| H[Defragment LOH]
  R[ArrayPool rent] -.->|reuse| D
  H[Dispose native resources] -->|deterministic| I[Free now]
  H -->|forgotten| J[Finalizer queue later]

conceptCards.title: Stack vs heap
conceptCards.summary: Value types inline in frames or inside objects. Reference types on heap. Boxing, async, and closures promote structs.
conceptCards.example: AuthStamp local on stack; same struct in class field lives inside heap object

conceptCards.title: Generations, LOH, POH
conceptCards.summary: Gen 0 nursery. LOH ~85 KB+. POH for pins since .NET 5. CompactOnce defragments LOH.
conceptCards.example: new byte[90_000] lands on LOH; GCHandle.Pinned goes to POH

conceptCards.title: Mark and compact
conceptCards.summary: GC traces from roots: stacks, statics, handles. Marks live graph, compacts SOH, frees dead.
conceptCards.example: Static cache dictionary roots all cached byte arrays

conceptCards.title: Dispose vs finalizer
conceptCards.summary: Dispose now on using block exit. Finalizer later on another thread. SkiaSharp needs using.

conceptCards.title: Allocation traps
conceptCards.summary: String concat, LINQ ToList, closures, boxing flood gen 0. Measure alloc-rate with dotnet-counters.
conceptCards.example: key += part in loop — use StringBuilder

conceptCards.title: GC modes
conceptCards.summary: Server GC for APIs. DATAS for variable load. Heap hard limits in containers. Never GC.Collect in requests.

conceptCards.title: V8 vs CLR
conceptCards.summary: Both generational tracing GC. CLR adds server GC, LOH/POH, IDisposable for native resources.
conceptCards.example: NODE_OPTIONS max-old-space-size vs GC heap limits

conceptCards.title: ArrayPool / MemoryPool
conceptCards.summary: Rent large buffers, Return in finally. Avoids LOH churn per request.

conceptCards.title: POH and weak refs
conceptCards.summary: Pin for interop on POH. WeakReference for caches that yield to GC.
